recommendation_en: Enteral vitamin D supplementation may be considered for human milk-fed preterm or low-birth-weight infants who are not receiving vitamin D from another source. (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendation_zh: 可考虑为未从其他来源获得维生素D的人乳喂养的早产儿或低出生体重儿进行肠内维生素D补充。（条件推荐，低确定性证据）
